title: Email: Fw: OPTION -    RE: Your Package was left at the Front Desk for you yesterday in the Building

content.subject: Fw: OPTION -    RE: Your Package was left at the Front Desk for you yesterday in the Building

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Renee Dasaro <DasaroR@courts.mi.gov>
Sent: Thursday, October 10, 2019 3:31 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: OPTION - RE: Your Package was left at the Front Desk for you yesterday in the Building 
 
Great!  Her name is Carolyn and her cell is 313-580-2715.  She will call you early this evening.

From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> 
Sent: Thursday, October 10, 2019 3:13 PM
To: Renee Dasaro <DasaroR@courts.mi.gov>
Subject: Re: OPTION - RE: Your Package was left at the Front Desk for you yesterday in the Building

Anthony Fenech
Detroit Free Press
Tigers beat writer
Twitter: @anthonyfenech

From: Renee Dasaro <DasaroR@courts.mi.gov>
Sent: Thursday, October 10, 2019 1:35:37 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: OPTION - RE: Your Package was left at the Front Desk for you yesterday in the Building

We have a clerk that lives on North Shore Drive in Lincoln Park.  Probably 5 minutes from the Allen Park address.  Would it be helpful to have her bring it home??? so you don’t have to make a special trip downtown.  If this would work, I will give you her name, address and/or cell number.

From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> 
Sent: Thursday, October 10, 2019 1:20 PM
To: Renee Dasaro <DasaroR@courts.mi.gov>
Subject: Re: Your Package was left at the Front Desk for you yesterday in the Building
Renee, hold off on putting it in the mail. I should have some time tomorrow morning to swing by and get it. I would like to bring it to Malta with me! I will be in touch then. Thank you again.

From: Renee Dasaro <DasaroR@courts.mi.gov>
Sent: Thursday, October 10, 2019 12:06 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: Your Package was left at the Front Desk for you yesterday in the Building

I am sorry about the confusion…I have the package and I will be happy to put in the mail to the Becker Avenue address.  It was left for you in the Free Press Bldg. on Fort Street but I now have it our offices in Cadillac Place.  If you should be downtown today and like to swing by Cadillac Place, I will hold off putting in the mail until tomorrow.

From: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com> 
Sent: Thursday, October 10, 2019 11:07 AM
To: Renee Dasaro <DasaroR@courts.mi.gov>
Subject: Re: Your Package was left at the Front Desk for you yesterday in the Building

Renee, I am so sorry for not getting back to you. I texted Brian a week ago saying I would get in touch with you. Did you leave it at the front desk at the Capitol? I am actually heading to Malta tomorrow so I don't think I'll be able to get up there in time. Is there any way you could send it to 9012 Becker Ave., Allen Park, MI, 48101?

From: Renee Dasaro <DasaroR@courts.mi.gov>
Sent: Thursday, October 10, 2019 9:25 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Your Package was left at the Front Desk for you yesterday in the Building
I am hopeful that you have received your package from Justice Brian Zahra.  Please confirm that you have received it.
